supporting_pages.title: "Data availability and durability \_|\_ Cloud Storage \_|\_ Google Cloud\
evidence_snippets: As a result, dual-region and multi-region buckets are designed to have a recovery time objective (RTO) of zero, and temporary regional failures are normally invisible to users; in the case of a regional outage, dual-region and multi-region buckets automatically continue serving all data that has been replicated across regions.

Redundancy across regions While traditional storage models often rely on an active-passive approach with "primary" and "secondary" geographic locations, Cloud Storage dual-regions and multi-regions provide an active-active architecture based on a single bucket with redundancy across regions.

Within the Google Cloud console, the Percent of minutes out of RPO graph lets you monitor the percentage of bad minutes during the past 30 days for your bucket when using default replication or turbo replication within dual-region or multi-region buckets.
